description: The function dereferences attacker-influenced vector positions without checking v.size(). IsohTest(v) is called first and itself reads v[ohType]; the function then directly reads v[typeName]. A short or empty vector therefore causes undefined behavior through std::vector::operator[], potentially crashing the process. Depending on the actual constant values and memory layout, the unchecked read may also consume unrelated memory, although crash/availability impact is the strongest supported consequence.
